g.text: PreToolUse:Workflow hook error: tierguard blocked this Workflow launch (2 problems). Fix and relaunch:
("research"). Investigation runs as investigate: on sonnet
{medium, high, xhigh}. Keep synth: for a stage
that owns the synthesis itself, and name it by that. Up to 10 opus agents can run at once here; the limit is
3. Keep at most the 3 most complex on opus and run the rest on sonnet (items.slice(0, 3) on opus,
items.slice(3) on sonnet), or batch them: for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += 3) await
Put exactly this in schema.properties of the inline schema object literal in each sonnet and haiku agent()
call (a shared schema const is not accepted): blocked_on: { type: ['string', 'null'], description: 'An open
decision this stage must not make, or null' }
If this is your second deny for the same workflow, stop and ask the user.
